title: Greek Newbuilding Investment Shapes the Next Fleet Cycle

Image reference: unsplash-image-q8MDl6ca_2k.jpg | assets/2026-11-24_greek-newbuilding-investment-shapes-the-next-fleet-cycle_img_unsplash-image-q8mdl6ca-2k_eedccb1e6a45.jpg
By Eirini Diamantara & Dimitris Roumeliotis
Greek owners account for more than one in five newbuilding orders placed in 2026 across bulk carriers, tankers, containerships and gas carriers, with 455 contracts out of 2,200 worldwide. Their participation in this year's contracting exceeds their share of the outstanding orderbook across the three main conventional sectors. Greeks represent 16.4% of new bulker orders against 11.3% of the global bulker orderbook, 30.7% against 27.0% in tankers, and 14.5% against 12.6% in containers.
